summary.text: Patient 12 is a patient with rheumatoid arthritis (age 37 years, sex F, ethnicity White) who has Chronic idiopathic urticaria treated with Omalizumab while on Adalimumab.
TNF inhibitor use was 90.3 weeks and type 2 biologic use 41.7 weeks, with dual biologic overlap of 41.7 weeks; conventional DMARDs during the overlap were Hydroxychloroquine.
Within the 6 month windows before dual biologic therapy corticosteroids were used for rheumatoid arthritis exacerbation; after dual biologic therapy corticosteroids were used for bronchitis.
